rig.force_axis: effective support-load vector rotates laterally while topology remains dual

keys.name: APPROACH_SEPARATE
keys.causal_role: before-state; support platform not yet acquired
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Body approaches with a visible gap to the two-anchor support.

keys.name: DUAL_PRECONTACT_ELIGIBLE
keys.causal_role: both target anchors enter reach before support acquisition
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Both feet are one row above the moving support; no teleporting contact.

keys.name: DUAL_ACQUIRE_EQUAL
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Both feet acquire before lateral loading; load share begins equal.

keys.name: LEFT_LOAD_ONSET
keys.causal_role: load ownership begins shifting without topology change
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Feet stay fixed; pelvis/COM bias left as the support-load vector tilts.

keys.name: LEFT_LOAD_MAX
keys.causal_role: maximum left-anchor force ownership with both contacts intact
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Root shifts toward left anchor while upper body counterleans farther left; right foot remains visibly planted but lightly loaded.

keys.name: LOAD_CROSSOVER
keys.causal_role: force polarity crosses center while contact topology remains unchanged
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Pelvis recenters first; head/arms retain leftward lag through the causal reversal.

keys.name: RIGHT_LOAD_MAX
keys.causal_role: opposite anchor becomes dominant without either contact releasing
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Root biases right while torso/head counterlean right; left foot stays planted with reduced load.

keys.name: LOAD_DECAY_BODY_OVERRUN
keys.causal_role: external load drops before body has finished its response
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Support demand decays but torso/arms continue rightward; body clock lags force clock.

keys.name: COUNTER_OVERSHOOT
keys.causal_role: secondary recovery crosses center after force has nearly normalized
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Torso counter-overshoots left while both anchors stay fixed; recovery is not reverse playback.

keys.name: DISPLACED_RESTACK
keys.causal_role: action-capable settle with stance/arm debt preserved
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Final support remains dual but body is not identical to precontact state; arm/torso asymmetry preserves recovery debt.
